scope: binned signed-centroid categorical Fisher and task-directed candidate design

model_contract.tail_contract: censoring=tail exposes left_censored/right_censored; censoring=miss folds finite-edge tails into miss
model_contract.clutter: optional unconditional p_clutter mass with an independent Gaussian law; remaining mass is miss
model_contract.jacobian_orientation: parameter_jacobian is d(local_design)/d(parameter), shape design x parameter

checks: analytic probability Jacobian agrees with central finite differences
state-dependent detection and clutter derivatives preserve derivative mass sum zero
categorical Fisher is PSD and finite-state mutual information matches exact cases
task+nuisance covariance reduction and Schur score are finite
greedy selection excludes unsafe candidates and records a common safe mask
